```{r}
# Clear the workspace and console.
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE)) 
cat("\f")

# Library packages
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(lsr)
```

```{r}
# read individual subject's csv file and compile
FilesList = list.files(pattern = "\\.csv$")
mergeddata <- data.frame()
for (i in 1:length(FilesList)) {
  fname=FilesList[i]
  subi <- read.csv(fname)
  subi <- subset(subi, trials.thisN >= 0, select = c("distractorpresence", "targetloc45", "targetdistractorcongruency", "search_resp.corr", "search_resp.rt", "participant", "trialtype", "probe_response", "targetletter", "distractorletter", "neutralletter1", "neutralletter2", "neutralletter3","distractorshape","circleletter","diamondletter","squareletter","hexagonletter", "circleloc","diamondloc","squareloc","hexagonloc"))
  mergeddata <- rbind(mergeddata, subi)
}
```

```{r}
# #-------------------------------------Probe Trial Data cleaning--------------------------------------------

# create new data frame for probe trials
probedata <- subset(mergeddata, mergeddata$trialtype == "probe")

# Assign a non-letter filler item for stimuli not appeared
probedata$distractorletter[which(probedata$distractorpresence == 0)] <- 0
probedata$neutralletter3[which(probedata$distractorpresence == 1)] <- 0

# test what letters were reported for each stimulus
for (j in 1:nrow(probedata)){
probe_resp<- probedata$probe_response[j]
probedata$seetarget[j] <- grepl(probedata$targetletter[j], probe_resp, fixed = TRUE)
probedata$seedistractor[j] <- grepl(probedata$distractorletter[j], probe_resp, fixed = TRUE)
probedata$seeneutral1[j] <- grepl(probedata$neutralletter1[j], probe_resp, fixed = TRUE)
probedata$seeneutral2[j] <- grepl(probedata$neutralletter2[j], probe_resp, fixed = TRUE)
probedata$seeneutral3[j] <- grepl(probedata$neutralletter3[j], probe_resp, fixed = TRUE)
# recode response to 1 & 0
probedata$seetarget[j] <- ifelse(probedata$seetarget[j] == TRUE, 1, 0)
probedata$seedistractor[j] <- ifelse(probedata$seedistractor[j] == TRUE, 1, 0)
probedata$seeneutral1[j] <- ifelse(probedata$seeneutral1[j] == TRUE, 1, 0)
probedata$seeneutral2[j] <- ifelse(probedata$seeneutral2[j] == TRUE, 1, 0)
probedata$seeneutral3[j] <- ifelse(probedata$seeneutral3[j] == TRUE, 1, 0)

# calculate the number of letters reported on each trial
probedata$num_letter[j] <- ifelse(nchar(probe_resp)/5 >= 1, nchar(probe_resp)/5, 0)
}

# create empty data frame
probealldata <- data.frame()
targetratealldata <- data.frame()
# calculate mean letter report rate by subject
for (i in unique(probedata$participant)) {
# create data frame for individual subjects
distractorpresencei <- probedata$distractorpresence[which(probedata$participant == i)]
targetloci <- probedata$targetloc45[which(probedata$participant == i)]
seetargeti <- probedata$seetarget[which(probedata$participant == i)]
seedistractori <- probedata$seedistractor[which(probedata$participant == i)]
seeneutral1i <- probedata$seeneutral1[which(probedata$participant == i)]
seeneutral2i <- probedata$seeneutral2[which(probedata$participant == i)]
seeneutral3i <- probedata$seeneutral3[which(probedata$participant == i)]
probesubi <- data.frame(distractorpresencei,targetloci,seetargeti,seedistractori,seeneutral1i,seeneutral2i,seeneutral3i)

# target report rate
# dis present, same object
TargetRate_dispre_same <- mean(probesubi$seetargeti[which(probesubi$distractorpresencei == 1 & probesubi$targetloci == "sameobject")])
# dis present, same object
TargetRate_dispre_other <- mean(probesubi$seetargeti[which(probesubi$distractorpresencei == 1 & probesubi$targetloci == "otherobject")])
# dis present, far
TargetRate_dispre_far <- mean(probesubi$seetargeti[which(probesubi$distractorpresencei == 1 & probesubi$targetloci == "far")])
# dis absent
TargetRate_disabs <- mean(probesubi$seetargeti[which(probesubi$distractorpresencei == 0)])
# overall dis pre mean
TargetRate_premean <- mean(c(TargetRate_dispre_same,TargetRate_dispre_other,TargetRate_dispre_far))

# distractor report rate
# dis present (only)
DistractorRate <- mean(probesubi$seedistractori[which(probesubi$distractorpresencei == 1)])

# neutral letter 1 report rate
# dis present
Neutral1Rate_dispre <- mean(probesubi$seeneutral1i[which(probesubi$distractorpresencei == 1)])
# dis absent
Neutral1Rate_disabs <- mean(probesubi$seeneutral1i[which(probesubi$distractorpresencei == 0)])

# neutral letter 2 report rate
# dis present
Neutral2Rate_dispre <- mean(probesubi$seeneutral2i[which(probesubi$distractorpresencei == 1)])
# dis absent
Neutral2Rate_disabs <- mean(probesubi$seeneutral2i[which(probesubi$distractorpresencei == 0)])

# neutral letter 3 report rate
# dis absent (only)
Neutral3Rate <- mean(probesubi$seeneutral3i[which(probesubi$distractorpresencei == 0)])

# Average neutral letter report rate
# dis present (average across Neutral shape 1 & 2)
meanNeutralRate_dispre <- mean(c(Neutral1Rate_dispre, Neutral2Rate_dispre))
# dis absent (average across Neutral shape 1, 2, & 3)
meanNeutralRate_disabs <- mean(c(Neutral1Rate_disabs, Neutral2Rate_disabs, Neutral3Rate))

# overall report rate (including incorrect reports)
overallRate <- mean(probedata$num_letter[which(probedata$participant == i)])
dispresentRate <- mean(probedata$num_letter[which(probedata$participant == i & probedata$distractorpresence == 1)])
disabsentRate <- mean(probedata$num_letter[which(probedata$participant == i & probedata$distractorpresence == 0)])

# probe report accuracy
correctRecallTotal <- sum(c(probesubi$seetargeti, probesubi$seedistractori,probesubi$seeneutral1i, probesubi$seeneutral2i,probesubi$seeneutral3i))
meanRate <- correctRecallTotal / nrow(probesubi)

subID <- i
distractorPresence <- c(1,0,1,1,0)
probeStimuli <- c("target","target","distractor","neutral","neutral")
reportRate <- c(TargetRate_premean,TargetRate_disabs,DistractorRate,meanNeutralRate_dispre,meanNeutralRate_disabs)
subimean <- data.frame(subID,distractorPresence,probeStimuli,reportRate, overallRate, meanRate, dispresentRate, disabsentRate)
# only include subjects who can recall on average at least 0.8 probe letter per trial
subimean$subinclude <- ifelse(mean(meanRate) > 1, 1, 0)

probealldata <- rbind(probealldata, subimean)

}
```

```{r}
# #-------------------------------------Search Trial Data cleaning--------------------------------------------
# Data trimming for individual subject
searchalldata <- data.frame()
# create new data frame for search trials
searchdata <- subset(mergeddata, mergeddata$trialtype == "search")

list <- unique(searchdata$participant)
for (i in list) {

# Create dataframe for the ith subject
distractorpresencei <- searchdata$distractorpresence[which(searchdata$participant == i)]
targetloci <- searchdata$targetloc45[which(searchdata$participant == i)]
targetdistractorcongruencyi <- searchdata$targetdistractorcongruency[which(searchdata$participant == i)]
searchACCi <- searchdata$search_resp.corr[which(searchdata$participant == i)]
searchRTi <- searchdata$search_resp.rt[which(searchdata$participant == i)]

# Data trimming
# same object
# cell condition data
same_raw <- ifelse(targetloci == "sameobject" & searchACCi == 1, searchRTi, NA)
# means and SDs
same_mean <- mean(same_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
same_sd <- sd(same_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
# trim data
same_trimmed <- ifelse(same_raw > same_mean - 2*same_sd & same_raw < same_mean + 2*same_sd, same_raw, NA)

# different object near
# cell condition data
other_raw <- ifelse(targetloci == "otherobject" & searchACCi == 1, searchRTi, NA)
# means and SDs
other_mean <- mean(other_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
other_sd <- sd(other_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
# trim data
other_trimmed <- ifelse(other_raw > other_mean - 2*other_sd & other_raw < other_mean + 2*other_sd, other_raw, NA)

# different object far
# cell condition data
far_raw <- ifelse(targetloci == "far" & searchACCi == 1, searchRTi, NA)
# means and SDs
far_mean <- mean(far_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
far_sd <- sd(far_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
# trim data
far_trimmed <- ifelse(far_raw > far_mean - 2*far_sd & far_raw < far_mean + 2*far_sd, far_raw, NA)

# distractor absent
# cell condition data
absence_raw <- ifelse(distractorpresencei == 0 & searchACCi == 1, searchRTi, NA)
# means and SDs
absence_mean <- mean(absence_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
absence_sd <- sd(absence_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
# trim data
absence_trimmed <- ifelse(absence_raw > absence_mean - 2*absence_sd & absence_raw < absence_mean + 2*absence_sd, absence_raw, NA)

# distractor present
# cell condition data
presence_raw <- ifelse(distractorpresencei == 1 & searchACCi == 1, searchRTi, NA)
# means and SDs
presence_mean <- mean(presence_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
presence_sd <- sd(presence_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
# trim data
presence_trimmed <- ifelse(presence_raw > presence_mean - 2*presence_sd & presence_raw < presence_mean + 2*presence_sd, presence_raw, NA)

# Trial Inclusion
trialinclude <- ifelse(same_trimmed | other_trimmed | far_trimmed | absence_trimmed, 1, NA)
proptrimmed_total <- 1 - sum(trialinclude, na.rm = T)/length(trialinclude)
proptrimmed_ACC <- 1 - mean(searchACCi)
proptrimmed_RT <- proptrimmed_total - proptrimmed_ACC

# Cell mean RT after trimming
same_rt <- mean(same_trimmed, na.rm=TRUE)
other_rt <- mean(other_trimmed, na.rm=TRUE)
far_rt <- mean(far_trimmed, na.rm=TRUE)
absence_rt <- mean(absence_trimmed, na.rm=TRUE)
presence_rt <- mean(presence_trimmed, na.rm=TRUE)
# Cell mean accuracy after trimming
same_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(targetloci == "sameobject")])
other_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(targetloci == "otherobject")])
far_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(targetloci == "far")])
absence_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(distractorpresencei == 0)])
presence_acc <- mean(searchACCi[which(distractorpresencei == 1)])

# subjects who showed suppression
suppressionindex <- ifelse(presence_rt < absence_rt, 1, 0)

subID <- i
trialtype <- c('sameobject', 'different-object-near', 'different-object-far', 'disabsent', 'dispresent')
RT <- c(same_rt, other_rt, far_rt, absence_rt, presence_rt)
ACC <- c(same_acc, other_acc, far_acc, absence_acc, presence_acc)
subimean <- data.frame(subID, trialtype, RT, ACC, proptrimmed_RT, proptrimmed_ACC, suppressionindex)
subimean$subinclude <- ifelse(mean(searchACCi) > 0.8, 1, 0)

#Add the ith subject's data to a combined dataframe
searchalldata <- rbind(searchalldata, subimean)

}

# remove subjects who didn't meet criteria
include <- searchalldata$subID[which(searchalldata$subinclude == 1)]
probeinclude <- probealldata$subID[which(probealldata$subinclude == 1)]
searchcleandata <- searchalldata[which(searchalldata$subID %in% intersect(include, probeinclude)),]
probecleandata <- probealldata[which(probealldata$subID %in% intersect(include, probeinclude)),]
letterloccleandata <- letterlocalldata[which(letterlocalldata$subID %in% intersect(include, probeinclude)),]

# overall search accuracy
mean(searchalldata$ACC)

# proportion trial abandoned
# by RT criteria
mean(searchcleandata$proptrimmed_RT)
# by ACC == 0
mean(searchcleandata$proptrimmed_ACC)

# recode for graphing
searchcleandata$RT <- searchcleandata$RT*1000
searchcleandata$ACC <- searchcleandata$ACC*100
searchcleandata$trialtype[which(searchcleandata$trialtype == "dispresent")] <- "present"
searchcleandata$trialtype[which(searchcleandata$trialtype == "disabsent")] <- "absent"
searchcleandata$trialtype[which(searchcleandata$trialtype == "sameobject")] <- "same-object"
probecleandata$distractorPresence <- as.character(probecleandata$distractorPresence)
probecleandata$distractorPresence[which(probecleandata$distractorPresence == "1")] <- "present"
probecleandata$distractorPresence[which(probecleandata$distractorPresence == "0")] <- "absent"
probecleandata$reportRate <- probecleandata$reportRate*100
letterloccleandata$reportRate <- letterloccleandata$reportRate*100

# summary statistics
# overall probe accuracy
mean(probecleandata$overallRate)
mean(probecleandata$meanRate)
mean(probecleandata$dispresentRate)
mean(probecleandata$disabsentRate)

# view summary statistics table
searchcleandata %>% group_by(trialtype) %>% summarise(meanrt = mean(RT), meanacc = mean(ACC))
probecleandata %>% group_by(probeStimuli, distractorPresence) %>% summarise(meanrate = mean(reportRate))
letterloccleandata %>% group_by(letterloc) %>% summarise(meanrate = mean(reportRate))
```

```{r}
# --------------------------------- Statistical Analysis ----------------------------------
# ------------------------------------For Search task-----------------------------------
# ANOVA for Search RT
RT.aov <- anova_test(
  data = searchcleandata[searchcleandata$trialtype != "dispresent",], dv = RT, wid = subID,
  within = trialtype, effect.size = "pes"
  )
get_anova_table(RT.aov)

# ANOVA for Search accuracy
ACC.aov <- anova_test(
  data = searchcleandata[searchcleandata$trialtype != "dispresent",], dv = ACC, wid = subID,
  within = trialtype, effect.size = "pes"
  )
get_anova_table(ACC.aov)

# --------comparing same and different-object-near--------------------

t_sameother_RT
cohensD(subset(searchcleandata,searchcleandata$trialtype =='same-object' | searchcleandata$trialtype=='different-object-near')$RT ~ 
         subset(searchcleandata,searchcleandata$trialtype =='same-object' | searchcleandata$trialtype=='different-object-near')$trialtype, method = "paired")

cohensD(subset(searchcleandata,searchcleandata$trialtype =='same-object' | searchcleandata$trialtype=='different-object-near')$ACC ~

         subset(letterloccleandata,letterloccleandata$letterloc == "same" | letterloccleandata$letterloc == "different-object-near")$letterloc, method = "paired")

# location-wise comparison: same vs. different-far loc letter recall rate

# location-wise comparison (regardless of target): different-near vs. different-far loc letter recall rate
t.test(letterloccleandata$reportRate[which(letterloccleandata$letterloc == "different-object-near" | letterloccleandata$letterloc == "different-object-far")] ~ letterloccleandata$letterloc[which(letterloccleandata$letterloc == "different-object-near" | letterloccleandata$letterloc == "different-object-far")], paired = TRUE)

         subset(letterloccleandata,letterloccleandata$letterloc == "different-object-near" | letterloccleandata$letterloc == "different-object-far")$letterloc, method = "paired")

# Probe report rate by rectangle
rectangledata <- data.frame()
for (i in unique(letterloccleandata$subID)) {
  
disrectangleratei <- letterloccleandata$reportRate[letterloccleandata$letterloc == "distractor" & letterloccleandata$subID == i] + letterloccleandata$reportRate[letterloccleandata$letterloc == "same" & letterloccleandata$subID == i]

neutralrectangleratei <- letterloccleandata$reportRate[letterloccleandata$letterloc == "different-object-near" & letterloccleandata$subID == i] + letterloccleandata$reportRate[letterloccleandata$letterloc == "different-object-far" & letterloccleandata$subID == i]

subID <- i
rectangle <- c('disrectangle', 'neutralrectanglerate')
reportRate <- c(disrectangleratei, neutralrectangleratei)
rectanglesubidata <- data.frame(subID, rectangle, reportRate)
rectangledata <- rbind(rectangledata, rectanglesubidata)

}

t.test(rectangledata$reportRate ~ rectangledata$rectangle, paired = TRUE) 
cohensD(rectangledata$reportRate ~ rectangledata$rectangle, method = "paired")
```
